title.en: Practical 11: T.S. of dicot stem and dicot root

text.en: Two slides look alike until you spot the vascular bundles.

The aim is to observe the transverse section of a dicot stem and a dicot root from permanent slides.
A dicot stem has vascular bundles arranged in a ring; bundles are conjoint, collateral, endarch and open; the ground tissue is cortex, endodermis, pericycle and pith, with collenchyma in the hypodermis.
A dicot root has radial vascular bundles, exarch and tetrarch xylem, Casparian strips and passage cells in the endodermis, and a cortex of parenchyma cells. Draw and label both sections.
